correctness.rationale: Algebraic counting gives 64 total elements and 8 units; exhaustive independent enumeration verifies exactly 55 nonzero one-sided zero-divisors, 420 underlying simple edges, and diameter 2. The verifier checks all matrices and all unordered vertex pairs.
